fomod.Name: Universal Frame Generation & Upscaling for Skyrim 1.6.1170
fomod.Author: veloha
fomod.Description:
NVIDIA DLSS and DLAA, AMD FidelityFX FSR, and Intel XeSS upscaling and frame generation through one in-game menu.
FOR SKYRIM SPECIAL EDITION 1.6.1170 WITH SKSE 2.2.6 ONLY. Each Skyrim version needs its own build, so if you are on 1.5.97 get the 1.5.97 build instead.
Everything is switched off until you enable it. Press PageDown in game to open the menu. Project source and licence: https://github.com/veloha/UFGU
